title: Real roots of non-centered random polynomials
summary: We study the fluctuations of the number of real roots of random polynomials with independent, nonzero-mean coefficients. Such non-centered ensembles arise naturally in signal-plus-noise models and in random perturbations of deterministic polynomials. While Ibragimov and Maslova (1971) established the leading asymptotics of the expected number of real roots for non-centered polynomials with i.i.d. coefficients, the corresponding variance asymptotics and central limit theorem have remained open for more than fifty years.
